case_title.correct_value: Om Pal Singh v. State of U.P.

number_of_accused.reason: Single appellant, Om Pal Singh, whose conviction is considered.

accused_gender.quote: the appellant parked his motorcycle at a distance of about 40 steps
accused_gender.reason: Accused is referred to with male pronouns throughout.

accused_age.reason: No age of the accused appears in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is described.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of the accused is stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No wealth, poverty or class statement about the accused appears.

previous_criminal_record.correct_value: Not stated (no conviction); a criminal case was pending against the appellant at Bareilly
previous_criminal_record.quote: on the basis of which a criminal case was pending against the appellant in the local Court at Bareilly
previous_criminal_record.reason: Judgment notes a pending criminal case and a theft complaint against the accused, which 'Not stated' omits.

victim_gender.reason: Victim Rishipal is male, referred to with male pronouns.

victim_age.reason: Victim's age is not stated in the judgment.

victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victim is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religious identity of the victim is described.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Prior enmity/dispute (rivals for liquor shop licence, earlier assaults and attempted killing)
accused_victim_relationship.quote: there was enmity between the deceased Rishipal and Om Pal Singh, the appellant herein for a number of years
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Prior enmity and the related hostile incidents are accurately described.

offence_category.reason: Conviction is for murder under s.302 IPC.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.302 (FIR initially under s.307, altered to s.302)
statutory_provisions.quote: the FIR was initially registered under Section 307 IPC ... the case was altered to 302 IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: Both the initial s.307 registration and later s.302 alteration are stated.

weapon.quote: He was armed with a double-barrelled gun.
weapon.reason: Weapon used is the double-barrelled gun.

evidence_type.correct_value: Eyewitness (PW-2, PW-3), medical evidence, dying declaration, recovery of motorcycle and articles from the spot
evidence_type.quote: Yezdi motor cycle at the spot ... basket in his motor cycle containing bags
evidence_type.reason: Main evidence types, including recovery of motorcycle and articles, are supported.

confession.reason: No confession or admission by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Earlier attempt to kill the deceased a couple of months before; shooting as deceased moved away
aggravating_circumstances.quote: only a couple of months before the present incident, he and his friends had encircled Rishipal with the intention of killing him
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Earlier attempt and shooting of the fleeing deceased are both described.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Convicted under s.302 IPC; rigorous imprisonment for life
trial_court_outcome.quote: the Trial Court convicted the appellant under Section 302 IPC, and sentenced him to rigorous imprisonment for life
trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court conviction and life sentence are accurately stated.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Appeal (Criminal Appeal No. 604 of 1980) dismissed; conviction and life sentence confirmed on 26.8.2002
high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court vide order dated 26.8.2002 confirmed the conviction and sentence of the appellant under Section 302 IPC
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court confirmed conviction and sentence; 'dismissed' is a fair reading.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, upholding conviction.

imprisonment_type.quote: sentenced him to rigorous imprisonment for life

imprisonment_years.reason: Life sentence is not a fixed term, so null is right.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.reason: Summary is accurate to the evidence, uses neutral references, and does not mention court proceedings or outcome.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment does not state the statutory punishment range for s.302.

attempt_completion.quote: Rishipal Singh died on 11.6.1978 at 9.40 p.m.
attempt_completion.reason: Victim was shot and died, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.correct_value: Death from multiple gunshot wounds to chest, abdomen, arms, hand, thigh and neck, a few hours after the shooting
physical_harm.quote: After few hours, the deceased died.
physical_harm.reason: Death and multiple gunshot injuries are accurately described.

number_of_offences.quote: The trial court convicted the appellant under Section 302, IPC.
number_of_offences.reason: Only s.302 conviction is discussed as charged and upheld; charge sheet sections are not separately stated.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is described.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Not expressly found as premeditation; earlier attempt to kill noted
premeditation_planning.quote: the appellant had tried to kill the deceased but he had managed to escape
premeditation_planning.reason: Court did not expressly find premeditation; the earlier attempt is noted accurately.

motive.correct_value: Accepted: prior enmity from competition for liquor shop licence and hostile incidents, including earlier attempt to kill
motive.quote: the motive was not introduced only at the time of the trial, in Court
motive.reason: Court accepted the prior enmity and history of animosity as motive.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Eyewitness testimony of PW-2 and PW-3; FIR narrating animosity; medical evidence; dying declaration
key_evidence_accepted.quote: The direct testimony of these two witnesses have been corroborated by the medical evidence and the dying declaration.
key_evidence_accepted.reason: All listed evidence was relied on by the Supreme Court.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Both eyewitnesses found consistent and clear; account corroborated by medical evidence and dying declaration
witness_credibility.quote: PW2 and PW3 have given clear and consistent eye-witness account.
witness_credibility.reason: Court found the eyewitnesses consistent and corroborated.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Fled the scene leaving the motorcycle behind
post_offence_conduct.quote: The appellant thereafter escaped, leaving behind his motorcycle.
post_offence_conduct.reason: Flight and abandonment of the motorcycle are accurately recorded.

custody_duration.reason: Judgment does not mention time in custody.

trial_duration.correct_value: offence: 11.6.1978; trial judgment: 21.3.1980; High Court: 26.8.2002; Supreme Court: 09.11.2010
trial_duration.quote: By order dated 21.3.1980, the Trial Court convicted
trial_duration.reason: All dates match the judgment; Supreme Court date is the judgment date.

legal_representation.correct_value: Appellant: Nagendra Rai (Senior Advocate) with others; State: S.R. Singh with others
legal_representation.quote: Nagendra Rai, Anurag Dubey, D.P. Pandey, Meenesh Dubey, S.R. Setia for Appellant.
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the judgment's appearance list.

investigation_status.correct_value: FIR registered; investigation completed; charge sheet filed 18.7.1978; trial completed
investigation_status.quote: He submitted charge sheet (Ext. Ka 15) against the appellant on 18.7.1978.
investigation_status.reason: FIR, investigation, charge sheet and trial are all supported.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Dying declaration recorded with no doctor present or fitness certificate, not in Q&A form, victim in serious condition; held not to render it unreliable
procedural_irregularity.quote: The absence of a certificate of fitness by the Doctor would not be sufficient to discard the dying declaration.
procedural_irregularity.reason: Court addressed these points and found them not fatal to reliability.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court: convicted under s.302, life imprisonment (21.3.1980); High Court: dismissed, conviction confirmed (26.8.2002); Supreme Court: dismissed
appeal_history.quote: The High Court vide order dated 26.8.2002 confirmed the conviction and sentence
appeal_history.reason: Outcomes at each level match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Rivalry proved; motive unnecessary given eyewitnesses; PW-2 and PW-3 from same village; dying declaration clear and properly recorded
prosecution_argument.quote: motive even though proved in this case, was not necessary to be proved
prosecution_argument.reason: All listed prosecution arguments appear in the judgment.

defence_argument.correct_value: Fabricated incident; multiple wounds inconsistent with single shot; motive made up; hearsay witnesses; unexplained cartridges; dying declaration unreliable
defence_argument.quote: Both the eye-witnesses PW-2 and PW-3 have stated that the appellant had fired only once

legal_principle_applied.correct_value: Dying declaration acceptable if magistrate satisfied declarant fit and statement voluntary and truthful; doctor's certificate a rule of caution; eyewitness consistency with medical evidence
legal_principle_applied.quote: A certification by the doctor is essentially a rule of caution
legal_principle_applied.reason: Principles match the Laxman guidance applied by the court.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Laxman v. State of Maharashtra (2002) 6 SCC 710 (relied on); Kanti Lal v. State of Rajasthan (2009) 12 SCC 498 (referred to); Modi's Medical Jurisprudence and Toxicology (19th Ed.) (referred to)
precedent_relied_upon.quote: Laxman v. State of Maharashtra (2002) 6 SCC 710 - relied on.
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Authorities and their treatment match the headnote and judgment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Judgment gives no sentencing reasoning; the appeal was decided on conviction.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court did not weigh aggravating factors for sentence.

other_sentence_order.reason: No compensation, directions or other orders are given.
